purpose: Documentary investigation priority only; no likelihood, direction, expected return or trade conviction.

rules.accession_citation: 1 if one or more exact source accession citations exist.
rules.clock_policy: Retrospective build at fixed cutoff, not historical known-at-time replay. Eligible/scored record clocks must not exceed cutoff except explicitly planned future dates. Original source objects and clocks preserved; no assumed first-public.
rules.consolidation: Exact sorted issuer CIK set plus exact accession set; revenue/loss share FINANCIAL family. Other source categories distinct.
rules.declared_filing_age: 1 for explicit source filing date 0–30 days before cutoff; 0.5 for31–90;0 older; missing null. Filing age is not novelty, first-public or availability.
rules.exact_period_context: 1 if explicit source_exact_period starts and ends exist; otherwise null, not zero or assumed comparable.
rules.extension_policy: Only the exact reviewed issuer/accession pairs in the fixed extension qualify under the two new categories. Repeated collection does not create another event or change the filing-age input. License milestone year-end labels are not an exact source period.
rules.source_review: 1 only for SOURCE_REVIEWED_WITH_LIMITS; original narrow extraction, not truth or tradability.
rules.ties: Descending score, newest explicit filing date (unknown last), sorted exact registrant CIK set, then stable thesis ID; not expected performance.
rules.unknowns: Unknown factor is null with null points. Score sums only known points, never renormalized. Coverage is separate. Null market data does not become zero.

selection: The same 905 records of the pinned released scanner plus a fixed three-record source-reviewed extension. Coherent Item 7.01 authorization and the TherapeuticsMD companion 10-Q license context are eligible as documentary research only. The Worthington earlier-disclosure comparison is a negative control, not a novelty verdict.
